items.say: Hi, I'm here to move with you. Copy me, nice and easy.
text: A few gentle moves to wake your body up: neck, shoulders, arms and sides.
Each move has a little timer. Go at your own pace, and make the moves as small as feels good.
Rests come in between. Stand, or sit on a sturdy chair: both work.

items.say: Strength time. Your own body is all the kit we need.
text: Wall push-ups, squats and marching on the spot. Slow and steady beats lots.
The count is a guide, not a target. Stop early whenever you like, and rest as long as you want.
A sturdy chair behind you makes squats easier: just touch it and stand back up.

items.say: Stretching. The slowest thing we do. I'm a big fan.
text: Ease into each stretch until you feel a gentle pull, then hold it and breathe.
No bouncing, and no forcing. A stretch should feel good, never sharp.
If one side feels different from the other, that's normal.

neck-tilt.name: Neck tilts
neck-tilt.cue: Ear towards your shoulder, slowly, one side then the other. Shoulders stay low.

shoulder-roll.name: Shoulder rolls
shoulder-roll.cue: Lift your shoulders up, roll them back, let them drop.

reach-up.name: Reach up
reach-up.cue: Arms up high, like you're picking fruit from a tall tree. Breathe out and lower.

side-bend-left.name: Side bend, left
side-bend-left.cue: Right arm up and over, lean gently to the left. Feel the stretch along your side.

side-bend-right.name: Side bend, right
side-bend-right.cue: Left arm up and over, lean gently to the right.

march.name: March on the spot
march.cue: Lift your knees at an easy pace and let your arms swing.

wall-push.name: Wall push-ups
wall-push.cue: Hands on the wall at shoulder height. Bend your elbows, lean in, push back.

squat.name: Squats
squat.cue: Feet hip-width, sit back like there's a chair, then stand tall.

lunge-left.name: Lunge stretch, left leg
lunge-left.cue: Step your left foot forward and bend that knee a little. Feel the stretch in the back leg's hip.

lunge-right.name: Lunge stretch, right leg
lunge-right.cue: Now the right foot forward. Easy does it.
